First public review candidate of the Open Security Metrics Standard (OSMS):
327 metric cards (190 reference + 137 truth-layer/steering), the card-contract
JSON schema and the reference validator.

**Public review:** 6 Jul – 15 Aug 2026 · **Freeze target for 1.0:** 30 Aug 2026
Submit findings: https://opensecuritymetrics.org/review

**Verify your download:** place `SHA256SUMS.txt` next to the zip and run
`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`. `MANIFEST-SHA256.txt` lists the checksum of
every catalog and schema file (paths relative to the repo root).

**Language note:** OSMS 0.9.1 is a native English generation of the full catalog
(structure and normative prose); language findings remain welcome via the *Language* category.

Specification and catalog: CC BY 4.0 · code: MIT.
